-- AAC Phase 1K
-- Resolve one centralized doctor-message route. Email is the V1 adapter; SMS and Empower remain pluggable.
SELECT
  @doctor_id AS doctor_id,
  NULLIF(@article_id, '') AS article_id,
  NULLIF(@campaign_id, '') AS campaign_id,
  @communication_type AS communication_type,
  LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.preferred_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) AS requested_channel,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.preferred_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) = 'email'
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(d.email), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'email'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.fallback_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) = 'email'
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(d.email), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'email'
    ELSE LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.preferred_communication_channel, ''), 'email'))
  END AS channel,
  CASE
    WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.preferred_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) = 'email'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.fallback_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) = 'email')
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(d.email), '') IS NOT NULL THEN d.email
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.preferred_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) = 'sms' THEN d.mobile_phone
    ELSE NULL
  END AS recipient,
  CASE
    WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.preferred_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) = 'email'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.fallback_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) = 'email')
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(d.email), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'READY'
    WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(d.preferred_communication_channel, ''), 'email')) IN ('sms', 'empower_chat') THEN 'ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE'
    ELSE 'NO_RECIPIENT'
  END AS routing_status,
  @subject AS subject,
  @message_text AS message_text,
  NULLIF(@action_url, '') AS action_url
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d
WHERE d.doctor_id = @doctor_id AND d.active = TRUE;

-- AAC Phase 1K
INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.communications`
(communication_id, doctor_id, article_id, campaign_id, communication_type, channel, recipient, status, sent_at, delivered_at, provider_message_id)
VALUES
(GENERATE_UUID(), @doctor_id, NULLIF(@article_id, ''), NULLIF(@campaign_id, ''), @communication_type, @channel, NULLIF(@recipient, ''), @delivery_status, IF(@delivery_status = 'SENT', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), NULL), NULL, NULLIF(@provider_message_id, ''));

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
VALUES
(GENERATE_UUID(), 'doctor', @doctor_id, IF(@delivery_status = 'SENT', 'communication.sent', 'communication.failed'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'n8n:send-doctor-message', NULL,
 TO_JSON(STRUCT(@communication_type AS communication_type, @requested_channel AS requested_channel, @channel AS channel, NULLIF(@error_message, '') AS error_message)));

SELECT @doctor_id AS doctor_id, @communication_type AS communication_type, @channel AS channel, @recipient AS recipient, @delivery_status AS status, NULLIF(@error_message, '') AS error;

parameters.content:
## AAC Phase 1K - SEND_DOCTOR_MESSAGE

Central communication router for all doctor-facing messages. It reads the doctor's preferred and fallback channels from BigQuery, uses Gmail for V1 email delivery, and records every success or routing failure in `communications` and `workflow_events`.

SMS and Empower are represented as adapters but intentionally remain unavailable until credentials/APIs are approved. If email is configured as the fallback, those preferences route safely to email.

Before activation, connect **Google BigQuery account** to both BigQuery nodes and **Gmail account** to the Gmail node. Keep inactive until a non-patient test recipient is confirmed.
